title: Operations Manager
description:
● Center Operations Management: Oversee the daily functioning of the Calicut center, ensuring seamless delivery of training programs, workshops, and student services.

● Academic Coordination Support: Collaborate with the academic team to ensure training schedules,classroom setups, and learning tools are well-organized and delivered without disruption.

● Process Optimization: Develop and refine operational processes to improve student experience,trainer efficiency, and resource utilization.

● Facility & Tech Management: Ensure all classrooms, labs, and IT infrastructure (software,

hardware, LMS platforms) are operational, updated, and adequately maintained.

● Budget & Procurement Oversight: Manage operational budgets, coordinate procurement of academic and office supplies, and ensure cost-effective resource allocation.

● Vendor Management: Liaise with external vendors for technology, logistics, maintenance, and support services, ensuring timely delivery and quality compliance.

● Compliance & Safety: Maintain adherence to organizational policies, regulatory guidelines, and ensure safety and hygiene standards across the premises.

● Student Services Coordination: Supervise non-academic support services like enrollment logistics,certifications, and grievance redressal mechanisms.

● Performance & Reporting: Track key operational KPIs and generate regular reports to support strategic decisions and continuous improvement.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
